AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND AND RESTATE ORDINANCE 83-3. AS AMENDED THIS ORDINANCE SHALL IMPOSE LICENSE FEES ON INSURER CONDUCTING BUSINESS WITHIN THE CITY OF CLERMONT; TO IMPOSE A GROSS PREMIUMS TAX ON INSURERS OPERATING WITHIN SAID CITY; TO PROVIDE A LICENSE FEE FOR INDEPENDENT INSURANCE AGENCIES AND BROKERS; TO PROVIDE ADMINISTRATIVE PROVISIONS; TO PROVIDE ENFORCEMENT; TQ PROVIDE AND EFFECTIVE DATE; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES. SECTION ONE

INSURERS LICENSE FEES. There is hereby levied for the year 1984 and for each year thereafter an annual license fee upon each insurer doing business within the City of Clermont, Georgia, in the amount of Fifteen and no/100 ($15.00) Dollars. For each separate business location in excess of one which is operating on behalf of such insurers within the City of Clermont, Georgia, there is hereby levied a license fee in the amount of Fifteen and no/100 ($15.00) Dollars. For the purposes of this Ordinance, the term "insurer" means a company which is authorized to transact business in the class of insurance designated in subsection (1) - (6) of 0.C.G.A. S 33-3-5. 11-216

ADDITIONAL BUSINESS LOCATIONS. For each separate business organization location, operated and maintained by a business

organization which is engaged in the business of lending money or transacting sales involving term financing and in connection with such loans or sales, offers, solicits or takes application for insurance through a licensed agent of an insurer; said insurer shall pay an additional license fee of Ten and no/100 ($10.00) Dollars for each separate business location from which an insurance business is conducted and which is not subject to the company license fee imposed by Section One, hereof, in the amount of Fifteen

and no/100 ($15.00) Dollars for each such location within the City of Clermont, Georgia. SECTION THREE

GROSS PREMIUMS TAX IMPOSED ON LIFE INSURERS . There is hereby levied for the year 1984 and for each year thereafter an annual tax based solely upon gross direct premiums upon each insurer writing life, accident and sickness insurance within the City of Clermont, Georgia, in an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the gross direct premiums received during the calendar year in accordance with 0.C.G.A. S 33-8- 8.1. Gross direct premiums as used in this section shall mean gross direct premiums as used in 0.C.G.A. s 33-8-4. The premium tax levied by this Section is in addition to the license fees imposed by Sections One and Two of this Ordinance.

GROSS PREMIUMS TAX, ALL OTHER INSURERS . There is hereby levied for the year 1984 and for each year thereafter an annual tax upon each insurer, other than an insurer transacting business in the class of insurance designated in subsection 1 of the 0.C.G.A. S 33-3-5, doing business within the City of Clermont, Georgia, in an amount equal to two and one-half percent (2.5%) of the gross direct premiums received during the calendar year, in accordance with 0.C.G.A. § 33-8-8.2. Gross direct premiums as used in this section shall mean gross direct premiums as used in O.C.G.A.

of each subsequent year. Any such license fee not paid by February 1, for each respective year shall be delinquent. SECTION STIX

ENFORCEMENT. The fees and taxes levied by this Ordinance may be enforced by execution in the same manner as other taxes of the City of Clermont, Georgia. A violation of this Ordinance shall be grounds for refusing or revoking a license, and the person responsible may be punished as for violations of other City Ordinances.

EFFECTIVE DATE. This Ordinance shall become effective January 1, 1984. SECTION EIGHT SEVERABILITY. In the event any portion of this Ordinance shall be declared or adjudged invalid or unconstitutional, by any Court of competent jurisdiction, it is the intention of the City Council of the City of Clermont, Georgia, that such adjudication shall in no manner affect the other sections, sentences, clauses or phrases of this ordinance which shall remain in full force and effect as if the invalid or unconstitutional section, sentence, clause or phrase were not originally a part of the ordinance. SECTION NINE REPEALER. All Ordinances and parts of Ordinances in conflict with this Ordinance are hereby repealed.

ORDAINED this first day of September, 1992, by the

Mayor and Council for the City of Clermont, Georgia.
